text:
maria: Incoming external assessment (CygnusSec) next Tue 09:00 PST. They need RBAC access window, KMS test vectors, and 30 days of audit exports. Can we confirm slots and exact evidence handoff?

 dylan: Ack. I'll carve out a 4-hour access window. Who owns the presigned log export?

 maria: Prefer to hand them a read-only S3 bundle + CloudTrail export + a KMS-proxy for decrypt test (no raw key material). They asked for decrypt against sample ciphertexts.

 sanjay: We should absolutely not provide direct Decrypt on production CMKs. Plan: create a dedicated test-CMK in prod project with key policy restricting to proxy role, and run a tiny proxy lambda that accepts signed requests and performs decryption. Ephemeral role for assessor with MFA requirement.

 dylan: Sounds good. I'll create a role `assessor/external-cygnussec` with `sts:AssumeRole` limited by source IP and time window. Policy draft:
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-logs/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/test-cmk","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:ViaAWSService":"lambda.amazonaws.com"}}}
  ]
}
```

 rita: Oncall FYI — if they attempt active exploitation we should pause. Who runs incident channel during assessment? :eyes: 

 maria: Security (maria) will be primary, rita backfill. Please ensure SRE has a canary fallback and we have snapshots of logs pre-window.

 ops-bot: INFRA-4721 created: `assessor-log-bundle-and-temp-role`. Presigned link: https://s3.redwood.example/pt/exports/1719998888

 dylan: I'll post the presigned log export to the ticket and add a README with exact file mapping (cloudtrail.jsonl, api-gw-logs/, app-audit/). Also will scope rate limits to avoid noisy scans.

 sanjay: For retest coordination — Cygnus asked for a 2-week retest window after fixes. Let's propose two options: same-week follow-up (if minor) or scheduled retest slot 2 weeks later. I'll block tentative slot and mark as optional in the ticket.

 maria: Agreed. Also request timeframe for evidence upload (they want signed attestations + request IDs). We'll maintain a zip and an S3 presigned URL with retention 30 days.

 dylan: Quick checklist I will attach to the ticket:
- create `assessor/external-*` ephemeral role
- deploy `kms-proxy` lambda + test vector
- export logs to S3 and generate presigned URL
- whitelist assessor IPs + MFA condition
- notify oncall and set incident pause playbook

 rita: Thanks — ping me when roles & proxy deployed, I'll rehearse the pause flow.

 maria: Thanks everyone. I'll run a 30-min dry run Fri 16:00 PST. Please RSVP on the ticket.
